aftercare.body: You'll be given clear, personalised aftercare advice at your appointment. In general: avoid touching or applying pressure to the treated area for the first 24 hours, protect your skin with SPF, and avoid facials, exfoliation or active skincare until it's safe to reintroduce them.
aftercare.title: Aftercare, made simple

consultation.body: Suitability for polynucleotides is discussed at your free, no-obligation consultation with Purdi, a Registered Nurse with the NMC, so any questions or concerns can be talked through honestly before you decide whether to go ahead.

items.answer: Before completing all treatments I will discuss your goals and the best way to achieve them. Some treatments don't necessarily require a separately booked consultation, however there is always an option for a free, no-obligation consultation before we start your journey together. It's an opportunity to have a relaxed chat about your goals, so you feel completely confident in both your chosen treatment and your practitioner before any decisions are made.
items.question: Do I need a consultation first?

items.answer: Most clients find polynucleotide treatment very comfortable. Numbing is used where appropriate, and time is taken to keep you at ease throughout. Any potential discomfort is discussed honestly at your consultation.
items.question: Will polynucleotide treatment hurt?

items.answer: Downtime is usually minimal and varies by treatment. You'll be given clear, personalised before and aftercare advice so you know exactly what to expect and how to look after your skin.
items.question: Is there any downtime?

items.answer: Polynucleotides and Under-Eye Polynucleotides are each £150 per 45-minute session, with a course of 3 recommended for best results. Purdi will confirm what's right for you at your consultation.
